title: feat(plugin-email,plugin-security): organization admins read their own organization's mail bodies again (option B), once one exported identity selector exists
body:
Filing gate **③**: the planned follow-up recorded by the #24688 landing (6279731318 context) and #24693's report ("option B").
- **Reader who acts:** the epic seat, then the `domain:services` lane.
- **Dedupe:** none open. Searched "option B mail body organization admin".

## Today
After #24688 (#24625), `body_text` / `body_html` of `sys_email` and `sys_identity_email` are readable only with `manage_platform_settings`. So an organization admin cannot read their own organization's tenant mail bodies, which carry no identity links.

## Preconditions (status)
- #24722: copies already in audit and activity are masked. **Merged.**
- The ceremony's identity-mail move (#24681): identity rows live in `sys_identity_email`. **Merged.**
- **One exported identity selector**, so that "is this an identity mail" is one function, not three copies. **Not built.** The ceremony's selector is in `cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts` (~3346-3376).
- See the separate card on archived copies. Until those are handled, option B must not widen the archive.

## Scope (measure first)
Grant body reads on `sys_email` to the row's own organization admin. Keep `sys_identity_email` platform-only. Pin the #24688 matrix with the new door, including the closed doors for every other principal.
